canonical_title: Automatic stall and departure prevention and recovery functions

versions.title_at_revision: Automatic stall and departure prevention and recovery functions
versions.text:
Standard: Automatic stall, departure, and spin prevention and recovery functions perform as effective as or better than pilot initiated procedures. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Analysis.
(1) Conduct analysis and simulation to assess the effectiveness of the stall, departure, and spin prevention and recovery functions, for each combination of regions of handling qualities, air vehicle states, flight phases, and environmental conditions. Test.
  (1) Lab test: Conduct piloted simulation and evaluation to assess the effectiveness of the stall, departure, and spin prevention and recovery functions for each combination of regions of handling qualities, air vehicle states, flight phases, and environmental conditions. Prior to entering operational test/operations, verify the standard by the above and following method(s): Test.
  (2) Flight test: Conduct flight test to assess the effectiveness of the stall, departure, and spin prevention and recovery functions for selected combinations of regions of handling qualities, air vehicle states, flight phases, and environmental conditions.
